scheme_name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Scheme

scheme_name: MSME Competitive (LEAN) Manufacturing Scheme
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)

benefits: 90% government subsidy on implementing agency and Lean consultant fees (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced levels).
eligibility_summary: Udyam registered manufacturing MSMEs operating as individual units or in clusters.

scheme_name: MSME Innovative Scheme - Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Assistance

benefits: Up to ₹1,00,000 for domestic patent, up to ₹5,00,000 for foreign patent, ₹10,000 for trademark, and ₹2,00,000 for GI registration.
eligibility_summary: Udyam registered MSME with registered patent/trademark applied in the current financial year.

scheme_name: MSME Innovative Scheme - Incubation Component for Startups
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: Financial assistance for nurturing innovative business ideas from students, startups, and MSMEs through approved Host Institutes (HIs).
benefits: Up to ₹15 Lakhs per approved idea for developing prototype and proof-of-concept + up to ₹1 Crore for seed capital support.
eligibility_summary: Innovator, early-stage entrepreneur, or MSME with validated innovative concept incubated at recognized Host Institute.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
department: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE / SIDBI)
description: Collateral-free credit facility for new and existing micro and small enterprises from member lending institutions (MLIs).
benefits: Collateral-free credit guarantee cover up to ₹5 Crore with guarantee coverage ranging from 75% to 85% of sanctioned loan.
eligibility_summary: New or existing Micro and Small Enterprises in manufacturing or service sectors with viable business model.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY - Tarun Category)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
description: Collateral-free business loans for established micro and small enterprises looking to expand commercial operations.
benefits: Institutional business loan from ₹5 Lakhs up to ₹10 Lakhs (and up to ₹20 Lakhs for established Tarun borrowers) without third party guarantee.
eligibility_summary: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises engaged in manufacturing, trading, or service activities.

scheme_name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Greenfield Enterprises
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore for setting up greenfield manufacturing, services, or trading enterprises by SC, ST, or Women entrepreneurs.
benefits: Composite term loan and working capital loan from ₹10 Lakhs up to ₹1 Crore with concessional interest rates.
eligibility_summary: SC / ST / Woman entrepreneur holding at least 51% shareholding in greenfield (first-time venture) enterprise.

scheme_name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
description: Financial assistance to early-stage DPIIT recognized startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and market entry.
benefits: Up to ₹20 Lakhs as grant for proof of concept/prototype; up to ₹50 Lakhs as debt/convertible debentures for commercialization.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT recognized startup incorporated not more than 2 years ago, with viable business model and less than ₹10 Lakhs external funding.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS)
department: National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC / DPIIT)
description: Credit guarantee coverage on loans extended by member lending institutions to DPIIT recognized startups without collateral.
benefits: Collateral-free credit facility up to ₹10 Crore with guarantee coverage up to 80% of sanctioned exposure.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT recognized startup with positive cash flow or revenue traction, certified by lending institution as viable.

scheme_name: DPIIT Startup Tax Exemption under Section 80-IAC of Income Tax Act
department: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) / DPIIT
description: 100% tax holiday on corporate income tax for 3 consecutive financial years out of 10 years from incorporation for innovative startups.
benefits: Complete exemption from paying income tax on corporate profits for 3 chosen financial years.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT recognized Private Limited or LLP company incorporated after 1st April 2016 with annual turnover under ₹100 Crore and approved by Inter-Ministerial Board (IMB).

scheme_name: Patent & Trademark 80% Fee Rebate and Fast-Track Examination for Startups
department: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
description: Substantial financial concession on patent and trademark statutory filing fees + free patent facilitator services + expedited examination.
benefits: 80% rebate on statutory patent filing fees and 50% rebate on trademark fees, with fast-track disposal within 12-18 months.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT recognized startup holding valid certificate at the time of patent application.

scheme_name: MeitY TIDE 2.0 (Technology Incubation & Development of Entrepreneurs)
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
description: Nurturing tech startups working on emerging technologies (IoT, AI, Blockchain, Robotics, CleanTech) through premier incubation centres.
benefits: Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EiR) fellowship of ₹4 Lakhs + Seed grant support up to ₹7 Lakhs and Scale-up funding up to ₹40 Lakhs.
eligibility_summary: Early-stage technology startup or individual innovator incubated at a recognized TIDE 2.0 incubation center.

scheme_name: MeitY SAMRIDH Accelerator Scheme for Software Startups
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY Startup Hub)
description: Matching government investment and acceleration support to software startups with demonstrated market traction to scale internationally.
benefits: Government matching investment of up to ₹40 Lakhs + 6-month intensive accelerator cohort with customer connections and venture pitching.
eligibility_summary: Software product startup with ready MVP, early customer traction, and raised funding or matched by recognized accelerator.

scheme_name: STPI Next Generation Incubation Scheme (CHUNAUTI Challenge)
department: Software Technology Parks of India (STPI)
description: Pan-India challenge hunt to empower software product startups especially from Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities in education, healthcare, and agritech.
benefits: Seed funding of up to ₹25 Lakhs + monthly stipend of ₹10,000 to intern founders + cloud credits and free co-working space.
eligibility_summary: Indian tech startup incorporated under Companies Act or registered partnership with innovative software product.

scheme_name: MeitY Chips to Startup (C2S) Programme
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
description: Training and supporting fabless semiconductor startups and researchers in VLSI, chip design, ASIC, and embedded systems.
benefits: Free access to electronic design automation (EDA) tools from Synopsys/Cadence + tape-out funding subsidies up to ₹50 Lakhs.
eligibility_summary: Fabless semiconductor startup, academic research spin-off, or MSME working on indigenous chip design and hardware architectures.

scheme_name: BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG) Scheme
department: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC / DBT)
description: Flagship seed funding program for innovative biotechnologists, medical device creators, and bio-startups to establish proof-of-concept.
benefits: 100% equity-free grant-in-aid of up to ₹50 Lakhs for 18 months to achieve proof of concept and validation.
eligibility_summary: Biotech startup incorporated not more than 5 years ago, or individual scientist/entrepreneur with registered incubation partner.

scheme_name: BIRAC Small Business Innovation Research Initiative (SBIRI)
department: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC)
description: Early-stage innovation grant for commercialization of high-risk biotechnical and pharmaceutical discoveries by Indian biotech companies.
benefits: Grant-in-aid covering up to 50% of R&D project cost (up to ₹1 Crore for early stage; up to ₹2.5 Crore for clinical trials).
eligibility_summary: Indian biotech or pharma enterprise with at least 51% Indian shareholding and dedicated in-house R&D laboratory.

scheme_name: iDEX - Innovations for Defence Excellence (DISC Challenge)
department: Defence Innovation Organisation (DIO), Ministry of Defence
description: Empowering startups, MSMEs, and individual innovators to develop indigenous cutting-edge defense and aerospace military solutions.
benefits: Grant-in-aid of up to ₹1.5 Crore (under DISC) and up to ₹10 Crore (under iDEX Prime) + field testing with Armed Forces + procurement fast-track.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT recognized startup or MSME with majority Indian ownership proposing tech solution to notified defence challenges.

scheme_name: ADITI Scheme (Acing Development of Innovative Technologies with iDEX)
department: Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence
description: Major financial grant scheme supporting development of strategic and critical technologies for Indian Armed Forces.
benefits: Grant-in-aid of up to ₹25 Crore per project for developing cutting-edge deep-tech military hardware and software.
eligibility_summary: Indian deep-tech startups and MSMEs with proven capability in quantum, AI, hypersonics, cyber defence, or stealth materials.

scheme_name: DRDO Technology Development Fund (TDF) Scheme
department: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)
description: Promoting indigenous development of components, sub-systems, and equipment for defence applications by private industries.
benefits: Project funding of up to 90% of total project cost (maximum ₹50 Crore) provided as grant-in-aid in milestone-based tranches.
eligibility_summary: Indian private company or MSME incorporated in India with majority Indian shareholding and demonstrated manufacturing/R&D base.

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme
department: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
description: Financial, technical, and business support for up-gradation of individual existing micro food processing units under One District One Product (ODOP).
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakhs per unit.
eligibility_summary: Existing or new micro food processing enterprise with owner contribution of minimum 10% of project cost.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana - Integrated Cold Chain & Value Addition
department: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
description: Creation of integrated cold chain and preservation infrastructure from farm gate to consumer to prevent post-harvest perishables loss.
benefits: Capital grant of 35% to 50% of storage and processing machinery cost up to a maximum grant of ₹10 Crore.
eligibility_summary: Firms, partnerships, private limited companies, cooperatives, and FPOs setting up modern pack houses, cold storages, and reefer vans.

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) Interest Subvention Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Medium to long-term debt financing facility for post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on bank loans up to ₹2 Crore for a maximum tenure of 7 years + CGTMSE fee coverage.
eligibility_summary: Agri-entrepreneurs, startups, FPOs, primary agricultural credit societies (PACS), and MSMEs setting up warehouses, silos, grading units.

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC) Scheme
department: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
description: Supporting agricultural graduates to establish commercially viable agribusiness centers providing fee-based agricultural extension services.
benefits: Composite loan up to ₹20 Lakhs (individual) / ₹1 Crore (group of 5) with back-ended capital subsidy of 36% (General) / 44% (Women & SC/ST).
eligibility_summary: Graduates or diploma holders in agriculture, horticulture, veterinary, dairy, or allied disciplines completing MANAGE training.

scheme_name: RKVY-RAFTAAR Agri-Startup Seed Grant Scheme
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Financial incubation and seed funding for agritech startups developing tech-driven solutions for farmers and rural markets.
benefits: Pre-seed stage grant of up to ₹5 Lakhs (Idea to PoC) and Seed stage grant of up to ₹25 Lakhs for product scale-up.
eligibility_summary: Agritech startups registered in India with innovative tech product in agriculture, dairy, fisheries, drone or precision farming.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) for Large Scale Electronics Manufacturing
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
description: Incentivizing domestic manufacturing and attracting large investments in mobile phone production and specified electronic components.
benefits: Incentive of 4% to 6% on incremental sales (over base year) of goods manufactured in India for 5 years.
eligibility_summary: Electronics manufacturing companies meeting target investment thresholds and incremental production targets in India.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for IT Hardware
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
description: Promoting indigenous manufacturing of laptops, tablets, all-in-one PCs, servers, and ultra-small form factor computers.
benefits: Incentive of up to 5% on incremental sales over base year + semiconductor design matching grants.
eligibility_summary: IT hardware manufacturing enterprises meeting minimum cumulative investment and annual incremental sales targets.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
department: Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
description: Boosting domestic manufacturing of critical Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Key Starting Materials (KSMs), and complex generics.
benefits: Financial incentive ranging from 3% to 10% on incremental sales of notified biopharmaceuticals and bulk drugs for 6 years.
eligibility_summary: Indian pharmaceutical manufacturers holding valid GMP certifications and meeting cumulative capex requirements.

scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Drones and Drone Components
department: Ministry of Civil Aviation
description: Incentivizing indigenous drone and drone component manufacturers to position India as a global drone manufacturing hub.
benefits: 20% incentive on value addition created in India (Sales turnover minus cost of raw material inputs) for 3 consecutive years.
eligibility_summary: Drone and component manufacturing startups and MSMEs with annual turnover of at least ₹2 Crore and min 40% local value addition.

scheme_name: FAME India / PM E-DRIVE Scheme for Electric Vehicle Manufacturers
department: Ministry of Heavy Industries
description: Subsidies for manufacturing electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers, buses, and commercial transport to accelerate electric mobility adoption.
benefits: Direct demand incentive per kWh of battery capacity credited to OEM on validated EV sales + charging infrastructure installation subsidy.
eligibility_summary: Automotive OEMs manufacturing certified electric vehicles meeting phased manufacturing program (PMP) localization norms.

scheme_name: SIDBI Make in India Soft Loan Fund for MSMEs (SMILE)
department: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
description: Quasi-equity and term loans on concessional terms for establishing new enterprises and modernizing existing manufacturing MSMEs.
benefits: Soft loan / quasi-equity up to ₹1 Crore at attractive interest rates + term loan up to ₹25 Crore with repayment up to 10 years.
eligibility_summary: MSMEs in 25 identified Make in India focus sectors with sound operational track record.

scheme_name: SIDBI Scheme for Purchase of Equipment for Enterprise's Development (SPEED)
department: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
description: 100% equipment financing for purchasing new machinery and equipment with fast-track processing within 48 to 72 hours.
benefits: 100% financing of equipment cost up to ₹1 Crore for micro units and up to ₹2 Crore for small units at low interest without cash margin.
eligibility_summary: MSMEs operational for at least 3 years with consistent net profits and satisfactory bureau credit ratings.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Grant Fund (TANSEED)
department: StartupTN (Tamil Nadu Startup and Innovation Mission)
description: Flagship seed capital grant for early-stage tech and social impact startups registered in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Equity-free grant of up to ₹15 Lakhs in two tranches to build MVP, validate market fit, and scale operations.
eligibility_summary: Startup registered in Tamil Nadu with DPIIT and StartupTN registration, incorporated within 5 years, with indigenous tech solution.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
department: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Promoting first-generation educated entrepreneurs to establish new manufacturing and service enterprises in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: 25% capital subsidy on project cost up to ₹75 Lakhs + 3% interest subvention for the entire loan repayment tenure.
eligibility_summary: Educated youth (Degree, Diploma, ITI) aged 21-35 (up to 45 for special categories) setting up new venture with project cost ₹10L - ₹5 Cr.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
department: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: Subsidy support for setting up micro businesses in manufacturing, service, and trading sectors by rural and urban youth.
benefits: 25% capital subsidy up to ₹3.75 Lakhs for manufacturing (project up to ₹15L), and up to ₹1.25 Lakhs for services/trading.
eligibility_summary: Unemployed individual passing Class 8 aged 18 to 45. Family annual income not exceeding ₹5,00,000.

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu FinTech Policy Regulatory Sandbox Grant
department: Guidance Tamil Nadu / FinTech City Chennai
description: Financial incentives and regulatory testing support for fintech startups establishing operations in Tamil Nadu FinTech City.
benefits: Rent subsidy of 50% for 3 years + testing grant up to ₹20 Lakhs for completing regulatory sandbox trials + API access subsidies.
eligibility_summary: Fintech startup registered in Tamil Nadu operating in payments, insurtech, regtech, or blockchain finance.

scheme_name: Karnataka Idea2PoC (Elevate 100) Grant-in-Aid Scheme
department: Department of Electronics, IT, Bt and S&T, Government of Karnataka
description: Premier startup competition offering equity-free grant-in-aid to top 100 innovative tech startups in Karnataka.
benefits: Equity-free grant of up to ₹50 Lakhs released in milestone-based tranches + free incubation and legal/IP assistance.
eligibility_summary: Startup registered in Karnataka with registered office and 50%+ workforce in Karnataka. Innovative idea in IT, Biotech, AVGC, Cleantech.

scheme_name: Karnataka Beyond Bengaluru Startup & GCC Incentive Scheme
department: Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM)
description: Special subsidies for IT, ESDM, and startup companies setting up operations in Mysuru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Mangaluru, and Belagavi.
benefits: Reimbursement of up to 50% rent for 2 years + recruitment subsidy of ₹10,000 per employee + patent cost reimbursement.
eligibility_summary: Tech company or GCC setting up minimum 20-seat office in tier-2/3 cities of Karnataka outside Bengaluru urban.

scheme_name: Maharashtra State Innovative Society (MSInS) Seed Fund Scheme
department: Maharashtra State Innovation Society (MSInS)
description: Direct seed funding support and government procurement work orders for innovative startups in Maharashtra.
benefits: Seed grant of up to ₹15 Lakhs for proof-of-concept + direct government pilot work order up to ₹15 Lakhs without standard tender.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT recognized startup registered in Maharashtra with functional prototype or validated product.

scheme_name: Maharashtra Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI) for MSMEs
department: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra
description: Comprehensive fiscal incentives including SGST reimbursement, electricity duty exemption, and power tariff subsidies for MSMEs.
benefits: Industrial promotion subsidy up to 100% of fixed capital investment + 5% interest subvention for 5 years.
eligibility_summary: New or expanding micro, small, and medium manufacturing units located in developing industrial talukas of Maharashtra.

scheme_name: Telangana T-Fund Seed Capital Scheme (in partnership with T-Hub)
department: Information Technology, Electronics and Communications Department, Telangana
description: Early-stage venture seed fund to co-invest with angel investors and venture capital firms in high-potential tech startups.
benefits: Seed investment of ₹25 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore in equity / convertible notes alongside leading institutional co-investors.
eligibility_summary: Tech startup registered in Telangana with demonstrable product traction and validation by T-Hub or state incubator.

scheme_name: Telangana WE-Hub Incubation and Seed Grant for Women Entrepreneurs
department: WE-Hub (Women Entrepreneurs Hub), Government of Telangana
description: India's first state-led incubator dedicated to women entrepreneurs across tech, FMCG, manufacturing, and social impact.
benefits: Seed grants up to ₹10 Lakhs + collateral-free credit facilitation through partner banks + international market access.
eligibility_summary: Enterprise with female founder holding at least 51% stake and registered in Telangana.

scheme_name: Gujarat Scheme for Assistance for Startups and Innovation
department: Industries and Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
description: Substantial financial assistance for innovative startups including sustenance allowances, seed grants, and marketing support.
benefits: Sustenance allowance of ₹20,000/month (₹25,000 for women) for 1 year + Seed grant up to ₹30 Lakhs for product development.
eligibility_summary: Innovative startup approved by recognized nodal institute in Gujarat under Gujarat Industrial Policy.

scheme_name: UP Startup Policy Seed Capital and Sustenance Allowance
department: Department of IT and Electronics, Uttar Pradesh (StartInUP)
description: Financial sustenance, seed funding, and incubation support to build a robust startup ecosystem across Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: Monthly sustenance allowance of ₹17,500 for 1 year + Seed capital grant of up to ₹5 Lakhs + Prototype grant up to ₹5 Lakhs.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT recognized startup registered in Uttar Pradesh registered on StartInUP portal with innovative tech product.

scheme_name: UP One District One Product (ODOP) Margin Money Financing Scheme
department: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Uttar Pradesh
description: Financial assistance for artisans, micro entrepreneurs, and units manufacturing notified ODOP indigenous products in UP districts.
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% of project cost (up to ₹6.25 Lakhs for projects up to ₹25L) and 20% (up to ₹20 Lakhs for projects up to ₹1 Cr).
eligibility_summary: Entrepreneur setting up manufacturing/processing unit of notified ODOP product in the respective district of Uttar Pradesh.

scheme_name: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM) Idea Grant Scheme
department: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM), Government of Kerala
description: Early-stage financial grant to help tech innovators, students, and startups convert hardware and software ideas into working prototypes.
benefits: Equity-free grant of up to ₹15 Lakhs awarded in milestones based on prototype progress.
eligibility_summary: Startup or innovator registered with Kerala Startup Mission with novel hardware, software, or bio-tech innovation.

scheme_name: Rajasthan iStart Fund & Bhamashah Techno Fund
department: Department of Information Technology & Communication, Rajasthan
description: Direct financial assistance and scale-up funding for startups rated on the Rajasthan iStart evaluation matrix.
benefits: Idea stage grant of ₹2 Lakhs, Viable product grant of ₹5 Lakhs, and Scale-up funding of up to ₹25 Lakhs (or matching angel round).
eligibility_summary: Startup with registered office in Rajasthan enrolled on iStart portal with QRate rating.

scheme_name: Startup Odisha Seed Fund & Monthly Sustenance Allowance
department: MSME Department, Government of Odisha (Startup Odisha)
description: Monthly living grant and product development seed funding for recognized startups in Odisha.
benefits: Monthly sustenance allowance of ₹20,000 (₹22,000 for women founders) for 1 year + Seed grant of up to ₹16 Lakhs for product development.
eligibility_summary: Recognized startup by Startup Odisha with operational entity in Odisha.

scheme_name: Bihar Startup Policy Seed Grant (Interest-Free Loan)
department: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar
description: Substantial interest-free financial assistance for 10 years to encourage young entrepreneurs to build scalable startups in Bihar.
benefits: Seed funding of up to ₹10 Lakhs provided as 10-year interest-free loan (convertible) + free incubation at premier state incubators.
eligibility_summary: Startup recognized under Bihar Startup Policy with innovative business model and registered entity in Bihar.

scheme_name: Assam Startup 'THE NEST' Venture Fund and Seed Grant
department: Industries & Commerce Department, Assam (Assam Startup)
description: Scale-up grant and venture funding for startups incubated at the marquee Assam Startup incubation hub 'THE NEST' in Guwahati.
benefits: Seed grant of up to ₹5 Lakhs for prototype + Scale-up matching grant of up to ₹50 Lakhs.
eligibility_summary: Startup incorporated in Assam incubated at THE NEST with innovative solution for North Eastern or national markets.

eligibility_summary: Registered business operating in Tamil Nadu in Manufacturing sector with annual turnover within ₹500,000,000.

description: Voucher grant for early-stage bio-entrepreneurs to utilize specialized incubation facilities and analytical labs. Administered under Himachal Pradesh Industrial and MSME Policy.
benefits: Up to ₹10 Lakhs voucher to access high-end laboratory testing and clinical trials.
eligibility_summary: Registered business operating in Himachal Pradesh in Biotechnology sector with annual turnover within ₹100,000,000.

scheme_name: Uttarakhand Quality Certification & International Standardization Grant
department: Department of Industries & Commerce, Government of Uttarakhand
description: Reimbursement of expenses incurred in acquiring ISO 9001, ISO 14001, CE marking, and BIS certifications. Administered under Uttarakhand Industrial and MSME Policy.
benefits: 100% reimbursement of certification audit and testing fees up to ₹2 Lakhs per standard.
eligibility_summary: Registered business operating in Uttarakhand in Manufacturing sector with annual turnover within ₹250,000,000.

scheme_name: Goa IT & ESDM Emerging Tech Development Incentive

description: Incentives for tech companies investing in artificial intelligence, IoT, and embedded hardware development. Administered under Goa Industrial and MSME Policy.
benefits: Reimbursement of up to 50% R&D equipment costs up to ₹30 Lakhs + patent filing subsidies.
eligibility_summary: Registered business operating in Goa in Software sector with annual turnover within ₹500,000,000.
